core_categories: Medical Devices; Hospital Supplies; Diagnostic Equipment; Surgical Systems; Orthopedic Implants
specialty_focus: Brasil Medical Distribuidora is a Brazilian medical device distributor specializing in supplying the Brazilian healthcare market with quality medical products. It is the exclusive importer and distributor of South Korea's Jeil Medical Corporation in Brazil, focusing on surgical, orthopedic, and maxillofacial titanium plating systems, including minimally invasive and trauma lines. The company has over 20 years of experience serving distributors with OPME expertise.
key_brands: Jeil Medical Corporation, Smart Surgical, others
